bundles.displayName: 政府项目免费体检与智能匹配
bundles.descriptionZh: 直连本地知识库完成企业画像、财务与知产复算、政策效力核验、高企/专精特新/小巨人预评估、多项目规划、可比同行对标与工业六基目录匹配。
bundles.descriptionEn: Run local-KB enterprise profiling, financial/IP verification, policy validity checks, high-tech/SME preassessment, peer benchmarking, and industrial catalog matching.
examplesZh: 帮我给这家制造业企业做一次免费政府项目体检，看看今年能报高企还是小巨人。
查一下宁波鄞州区2026年有效的专精特新和研发机构政策，并拉一份可比同行名单。
核对一下企业近三年研发费用率、资产负债表和专利有效期，写入主体黑板。
examplesEn: Run a government grant checkup for this manufacturer and rank High-Tech vs. Little Giant eligibility.
Check valid 2026 SME and R&D center policies for Yinzhou, Ningbo and list comparable peers.
Verify 3-year R&D ratio, balance sheet identity, and patent validity, then save to the facts blackboard.

bundles.displayName: 申报材料质检、对比与润色审计
bundles.descriptionZh: 对申报书执行一致性与防串户体检、两版 DOCX 原生章节与表格移动对比、证据台账算术复算，以及中文去 AI 味润色保真硬门禁审计。
bundles.descriptionEn: Audit application consistency, natively diff DOCX versions with moved sections/rows, verify evidence-ledger arithmetic, and enforce numeric fidelity on prose rewrites.
examplesZh: 帮我检查这份高企申报书有没有占位符、跨企业串户或免责兜底套话。
把修改前后的两版申报书 Word 做一次原生版本对比，标出移动的章节和改过的数字。
复算这份证据台账里的全部占比公式，并检查润色后的正文有没有丢掉 ppm 或 MPa 指标。
examplesEn: Audit this application DOCX for placeholders, cross-company contamination, or defensive hedging.
Compare the old and revised DOCX applications and highlight moved sections, reordered rows, and changed figures.
Recompute every formula in this evidence ledger and verify that rewriting preserved all ppm/MPa metrics.

bundles.displayName: 国家高新技术企业申请书撰写
bundles.descriptionZh: 国家高新技术企业认定申请书 RD/PS 表扩缩、高密度正文撰写、OOXML 精准回填与全维度严格门禁验收。
bundles.descriptionEn: Draft, expand, populate, and strictly audit National High-Tech Enterprise application DOCX forms (RD, PS, and innovation sections).
examplesZh: 按企业审计报告和专利清单，把高企申请书空白母版扩成 6 个 RD 表和 2 个 PS 表并回填完整正文。
逐项撰写 RD 目的及组织实施方式、核心技术及创新点、PS 竞争优势与企业创新能力四栏，并通过严格审计。
examplesEn: Expand the High-Tech application DOCX master into 6 RD and 2 PS tables and populate full prose from verified evidence.
Draft dense RD purpose/implementation, core innovations, PS advantages, and innovation sections passing strict audit.

bundles.displayName: 专精特新小巨人与单项冠军撰写
bundles.descriptionZh: 专精特新中小企业、国家级小巨人、制造业单项冠军与质量品牌项目的方向卡、六大核心问题正文、技术-产品-收入主矩阵与 A-D 级市占率测算交付。
bundles.descriptionEn: Deliver SME/Little Giant/Manufacturing Single Champion direction cards, 6-question narratives, tech-product-revenue matrices, and A-D market-share workpapers.
examplesZh: 为这家制造企业编制 2026 版小巨人前期培育方向卡和六大核心问题高密度申请正文。
生成面向浙江省制造业单项冠军（single_champion）的技术—产品—收入两链汇合主矩阵。
examplesEn: Build a 2026 Little Giant direction card and full six-question narrative for this manufacturer.
Generate a single_champion technology-product-revenue master matrix and A-D market-share workpaper.

bundles.displayName: 通用政府专项申报与可行性报告
bundles.descriptionZh: 一站式承接省级企业研究院、首台套/首批次/首版次、技改设备更新、智能/未来工厂、绿色工厂、现代农业、领军人才、外贸跨境、知产强企及通用可行性报告撰写与硬门禁核验。
bundles.descriptionEn: Draft and strictly validate 10 specialized government grant tracks (R&D institutes, three-first, tech renovation, smart/green factories, agriculture, talent, trade, IP, and feasibility reports).
examplesZh: 按 169 号文核验省级企业研究院申报条件并撰写完整建设方案与可行性报告。
核对这套技改设备更新台账（含 5% 质保金）的适格投资额，并生成绿色工厂绩效自评价。
examplesEn: Validate Provincial Enterprise Research Institute eligibility (Doc #169) and draft the feasibility report.
Reconcile eligible fixed-asset renovation investments (with 5% retention) and validate green factory KPIs.

bundles.displayName: 中国专利申请文件核稿与批注
bundles.descriptionZh: 检查中国专利申请 Word 的摘要、权利要求、说明书、附图、引用关系与公开充分性，生成带保护范围影响评估的精准 OOXML 批注副本。
bundles.descriptionEn: Review Chinese patent application DOCX files for claim scope, references, terminology, and sufficiency, producing precision OOXML-annotated copies.
examplesZh: 核稿这份发明专利申请文件 Word，输出逐条保护范围影响意见并写入精准批注副本。
examplesEn: Review this Chinese invention patent DOCX and generate an annotated copy with scope-impact findings.

bundles.displayName: 专利查新、挖掘、布局与双中心预审
bundles.descriptionZh: 公司级专利综合战略助手，覆盖查新检索、挖掘交底、AI 软件发明、跨类权利要求特征树解析、FTO 与浙江/杭州双保护中心预审通道推荐。
bundles.descriptionEn: Comprehensive enterprise patent strategy assistant covering novelty search, mining, AI inventions, cross-category claim graphs, FTO, and Zhejiang/Hangzhou pre-exam routing.
examplesZh: 帮我分析这份通信加密专利的权利要求特征树与 H04L 分类号，并推荐浙江还是杭州预审中心。
examplesEn: Analyze this encryption patent's claim graph and H04L IPC classification and recommend Zhejiang vs. Hangzhou pre-exam center.

bundles.displayName: 技术标准起草与GB-T1.1严格审查
bundles.descriptionZh: 按 GB/T 1.1 起草国家、行业、地方、团体与企业标准草案及编制说明，内置规范性引用交叉核验、试验方法非空检查与全量占位符硬门禁。
bundles.descriptionEn: Draft GB/T 1.1 national, industry, group, and enterprise standards with strict normative-citation, test-method, and placeholder auditing.
examplesZh: 帮我起草一份高阻隔复合膜企业标准草案和编制说明，并运行 GB/T 1.1 严格门禁检查。
examplesEn: Draft an enterprise standard and compilation note for high-barrier film and run strict GB/T 1.1 checks.

bundles.displayName: 企业全景尽调与新公司法合规核查
bundles.descriptionZh: 企业合作前公开信息全景尽调与合规核查，内置 GB 32100 信用代码硬校验、新《公司法》2027-06-30 实缴过渡期核算与本地法规检索，交付 A/B/C 版报告。
bundles.descriptionEn: Pre-cooperation enterprise due diligence and legal compliance check with GB 32100 USCC validation, 2024 Company Law paid-in calculator, and A/B/C reports.
examplesZh: 对这家拟合作制造企业做一份 A 版全景尽调报告，同时核验其认缴出资是否触发 2027-06-30 新公司法整改红线。
examplesEn: Produce a Standard Panorama Due Diligence report and verify whether subscribed capital triggers the 2027-06-30 Company Law deadline.

bundles.displayName: 制造企业财税复算与智慧税务风控
bundles.descriptionZh: 基于制造企业三表复算现金流与财务健康、筛查智慧税务与账票税款货一致性，支持高研发费率无崩溃预警与跨企业串户硬拦截，交付深度风控报告。
bundles.descriptionEn: Recompute manufacturing 3-statement financials, screen smart-tax risks with strict cross-company isolation and >100% R&D tolerance, and deliver deep risk reports.
examplesZh: 复算这家制造企业近三年财务三表和现金流健康指标，筛查智慧税务风险并输出深度整改报告。
examplesEn: Recompute 3-year manufacturing financial statements, screen smart-tax risks, and deliver a deep remediation report.
